description: Source code for Slack import service in Mattermost, including data structures, import logic, user/channel/post/file handling, and integration with Mattermost store and actions.

classes.name: slackChannel
classes.description: Represents a Slack channel with metadata such as ID, name, creator, members, purpose, topic, and type.

classes.name: slackChannelSub
classes.description: Represents a subfield of a Slack channel, such as purpose or topic value.

classes.name: slackProfile
classes.description: Contains user profile information including first name, last name, and email.

classes.name: slackUser
classes.description: Represents a Slack user with ID, username, and profile.

classes.name: slackFile
classes.description: Represents a file with ID and title.

classes.name: slackPost
classes.description: Represents a Slack post/message with user, bot info, text, timestamp, subtype, comments, files, and attachments.

classes.name: Actions
classes.description: Provides functions for user and channel management, file uploads, cache invalidation, and image processing during Slack import.

classes.name: SlackImporter
classes.description: Main service class for importing Slack data into Mattermost, managing store, actions, config, and import process.

methods.name: SlackImport
methods.description: Main method to import Slack zip data into Mattermost, parsing channels, users, posts, and files, then creating corresponding entities.

methods.name: slackAddUsers
methods.description: Adds Slack users to Mattermost, creating new users or merging with existing ones, and sending password reset emails.

methods.name: slackAddBotUser
methods.description: Creates a bot user for Slack import and adds it to Mattermost.

methods.name: slackAddChannels
methods.description: Creates or merges channels from Slack data, adds members, and imports posts.

methods.name: oldImportPost
methods.description: Inserts a post into Mattermost, handling message chunking and file attachments.

methods.name: oldImportUser
methods.description: Creates or updates a user in Mattermost during import, verifying email if admin import.

methods.name: oldImportChannel
methods.description: Creates or merges a channel, handling direct, group, and private channels.

methods.name: oldImportFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to Mattermost, generating thumbnails and previews if applicable.

methods.name: oldImportIncomingWebhookPost
methods.description: Creates a post from webhook data, replacing links and setting properties.
